name: One-tap start
desc: The app opens on a single Start button. No menus before the first action.

name: Two-minute door
desc: The default first session is 2 minutes. Finishing it counts as a full win.

name: Just-open streak
desc: Opening the app before a set hour is itself a streak.

name: Five-second launch
desc: A 5-4-3-2-1 countdown starts the timer automatically, so there is no time to argue with yourself.

name: Next tiny step card
desc: Home shows one action only, written as a physical verb: "Open notebook to page 12."

name: If-then plans
desc: Create rules like "When I finish dinner, I open the app." The app reminds you at the cue. (Implementation intentions)

name: Habit stacking
desc: Attach a session to a routine you already have, like morning tea or the college bus.

name: Temptation bundling
desc: A favourite playlist plays only during sessions.

name: Start ritual
desc: The same 20-second sequence every time (sound, one breath, tap) becomes the cue to work.

name: Resume where I left
desc: Start screen shows the last note you wrote to yourself.

name: Parking note
desc: At session end, write one line: the exact next step for future you.

name: Ugly first draft mode
desc: The session goal is "make it bad on purpose." Kills perfectionism.

name: Setup-only session
desc: The only goal is to open the files and clear the desk.

name: Dice start
desc: Cannot choose? The app rolls among today's three tasks.

name: Bad-day bar
desc: A slider drops the daily minimum to 1 minute on rough days.

name: Home-screen widget
desc: Start button and streak number without opening the app.

name: Quick-settings tile
desc: Start a session from the phone's pull-down panel.

name: Voice start
desc: "Start five minutes on DSA."

name: NFC desk tag
desc: Tap your phone on a sticker at your desk to start.

name: Location cue
desc: Arriving at the library offers a session.

name: Charger cue
desc: Plugging in at your desk triggers a start prompt.

name: Morning first win
desc: One 2-minute task before any other app is opened.

name: Start count
desc: Lifetime "times started" is the biggest number on the home screen.

name: Starting-delay meter
desc: Tracks the gap between planned start and real start. The goal is to shrink it.

name: No-zero day
desc: Any single logged action keeps the day from being a zero.

name: Streak per action
desc: Each tiny action (opened book, wrote 50 words, one commit) has its own counter.

name: Master streak
desc: One overall "showed up" streak, fed by any action.

name: Full and tiny versions
desc: Each habit has a full version and a tiny one. The tiny one keeps the streak.

name: Weekly streaks
desc: "4 days out of 7" for habits that need not be daily.

name: In-day chain
desc: Back-to-back sessions build a chain inside one day.

name: Heatmap grid
desc: A GitHub-style year grid per habit.

name: Chain calendar
desc: A month view with crossed-off days. (Don't break the chain)

name: Growing flame
desc: The streak icon grows at 3, 7, 14, 30, 66 and 100 days.

name: 66-day track
desc: A bar toward 66 days, the median time to automatic habit in one UCL study.

name: Before-noon streak
desc: Days with a session started before 12.

name: Early-submit streak
desc: Submissions made 24 hours or more before the deadline.

name: Plan-kept streak
desc: Days you did what you planned.

name: Wake-time streak
desc: Days you got up within 30 minutes of target.

name: Review streak
desc: Days with the evening reflection done.

name: Upload streak
desc: Days with proof of work saved.

name: Hard-thing-first streak
desc: Days the most dreaded task was done first.

name: Stacking bonus
desc: Three streaks alive on the same day earns a multiplier.

name: Current and longest
desc: Both shown side by side.

name: Total days done
desc: A lifetime count that never resets, shown next to the streak.

name: Odd milestones
desc: Surprise rewards at 11, 23 and 47 days. (Variable reward)

name: Streak wager
desc: Bet XP that you will reach 7 days.

name: Active days
desc: Choose which days count, for example no Sundays.

name: Time-window streaks
desc: The action counts only inside its window, like 6 to 9 am.

name: Graduation
desc: When a habit runs on its own, move it to "maintained" and free the slot for a new one.

name: Never miss twice
desc: One miss is a pause. Only two in a row counts as a break.

name: Streak freeze
desc: Two per month, applied automatically.

name: Earned freezes
desc: Every 7-day run earns one more.

name: Grace window
desc: The day ends at 3 am, not midnight.

name: Decay, not reset
desc: A break costs 20% of the streak instead of all of it.

name: Comeback counter
desc: Counts how many times you returned after a miss.

name: Comeback bonus
desc: The first session after a gap pays double XP.

name: Repair task
desc: Restore yesterday by doing a double minimum today.

name: Sick and travel mode
desc: Pause all streaks with a reason.

name: Exam mode
desc: Swaps normal habits for an exam set with no streak loss.

name: Kind break message
desc: No red screens and no shaming text.

name: Miss autopsy
desc: One tap for the reason: tired, forgot, avoided, busy.

name: Miss pattern finder
desc: Shows which weekday and which reason repeat.

name: Restart at tiny
desc: After a break, the habit runs at its tiny version for 3 days.

name: Fresh-start dates
desc: Mondays, the 1st and your birthday prompt a restart. (Fresh start effect)

name: Slip guard
desc: After one slip the app says: "The day is not lost. Two minutes saves it." (Counters the what-the-hell effect)

name: Evening rescue
desc: A 9 pm alert on a zero day with a one-tap 2-minute session.

name: Half-credit days
desc: Partial work shows as a half-filled square.

name: 30-day consistency
desc: A percentage over the last 30 days, shown beside the streak.

name: Gifted freeze
desc: A buddy can give you one of theirs.

name: Return screen
desc: After 3 or more days away you see one button, "Start again," and no stats.

name: Lapse plan
desc: Your pre-written "if I miss, I will..." shown at the moment of the miss.

name: Friend test
desc: Prompt: write what you would say to a friend who missed a day.

name: Archive, never delete
desc: Old streaks stay in history as proof you can do it.

name: Gold bad days
desc: Days you worked despite a low mood are marked gold.

name: Presets
desc: 2, 5, 15, 25, 50 and 90 minutes.

name: Pomodoro cycles
desc: Work and break rounds that run on their own.

name: Flowtime
desc: Count up, stop when focus fades, and get a break sized to the work.

name: Just five more
desc: At the end, one tap adds 5 minutes.

name: Ramp ladder
desc: Session length grows by 1 minute a day.

name: Work and rest themes
desc: The whole screen changes look between WORK and REST.

name: Session intention
desc: Type one line before you start.

name: Session outcome
desc: Done, partly, or stuck, chosen at the end.

name: Daily challenge
desc: For example "3 sessions before 2 pm."

name: Weekly boss
desc: One big challenge, judged on Sunday night.

name: Monthly campaign
desc: A 30-day themed challenge.

name: Mission card
desc: A random mini challenge appears some days. (Variable reward)

name: Beat yesterday
desc: Today's target is yesterday's focus minutes plus one.

name: Ghost race
desc: Race a line showing your own best day.

name: Hard mode
desc: Leaving the app fails the session.

name: Soft mode
desc: Two pauses allowed, each with a reason.

name: Wander tally
desc: Tap when your mind drifts. No penalty, only awareness.

name: Strict breaks
desc: The break has a hard end, and overruns are counted.

name: Break menu
desc: Suggests a walk, water or a stretch, never social media.

name: Hidden clock
desc: Hide the digits to stop clock-watching.

name: Ambient sounds
desc: Rain, cafe, brown noise.

name: Session tags
desc: Study, code, write, admin.

name: Difficulty rating
desc: Hard sessions pay more XP.

name: Marathon day
desc: An optional 6-session challenge with enforced breaks.

name: Session receipt
desc: A summary card after each session: time, task, proof.

name: Fake deadline
desc: The app sets your personal due date 48 hours before the real one.

name: Sessions left
desc: Countdown shown in work sessions remaining, not days.

name: Backward planner
desc: Splits a deadline into dated milestones.

name: First-touch rule
desc: Every new assignment gets a 5-minute session within 24 hours.

name: Day-one streak
desc: Counts assignments touched on the day they were given.

name: Panic simulator
desc: Shows hours per day needed if you start today versus in 5 days.

name: Pace line
desc: A chart of work done against the pace required.

name: Neck-level alarm
desc: Fires when work left exceeds realistic hours left.

name: Cost-of-delay note
desc: Write what the last all-nighter cost you. It reappears at the next delay.

name: Future-self letter
desc: A message from you, the morning after the deadline.

name: Decaying bonus
desc: A bonus for early work that shrinks each day you wait. (Flips present bias)

name: Early-bird multiplier
desc: 3x XP a week early, 1x on the last day.

name: Draft-zero deadline
desc: A complete ugly version is due at the halfway point.

name: Submission buffer
desc: Goal: submit 12 hours early.

name: Load calendar
desc: Weeks coloured by how heavy they are.

name: Collision warning
desc: Alerts when three deadlines land in one week.

name: Daily quota
desc: Minutes per day worked out for each deadline.

name: Visible rollover
desc: A missed quota is spread over the days left, and you see the new number.

name: Delay debt meter
desc: Total backlog in minutes.

name: Postpone friction
desc: Delaying a task means typing a reason.

name: Postpone limit
desc: The third postpone forces you to split the task or delete it.

name: Delay count
desc: Each task shows how many times it was pushed.

name: Shared due date
desc: Send the deadline to a buddy.

name: Deadline post-mortem
desc: When you started, when you finished, one lesson.

name: Start-by date
desc: Every task shows "start by," not only "due."

name: Proof at session end
desc: Add a photo, file, link or note.

name: Camera-first capture
desc: One tap to photograph a notebook page.

name: One-line log
desc: "What I did," in a sentence.

name: Voice proof
desc: A 20-second voice note.

name: Link proof
desc: A GitHub commit or document link.

name: GitHub sync
desc: Commits count as proof automatically.

name: Timeline feed
desc: A scrollable history of all proof.

name: Project gallery
desc: Proof grouped by project.

name: Before and after pairs
desc: Two images side by side.

name: Daily page
desc: The day's work assembled into one page.

name: Weekly digest
desc: A shareable summary card.

name: Proof-required mode
desc: For chosen habits, the streak counts only with proof.

name: Done list
desc: A running list of finished things, the opposite of a to-do list.

name: Evidence wall
desc: Pinned items under "proof I can do hard things."

name: Unit counters
desc: Words, pages or problems recorded per upload.

name: Lifetime counters
desc: Total problems solved, total pages written.

name: Portfolio export
desc: Pick your best items for a resume or portfolio.

name: Share card
desc: An image sized for WhatsApp status.

name: Local-first storage
desc: Works offline, with cloud backup.

name: Backup status
desc: A warning icon when the vault is not backed up.

name: On this day
desc: Shows what you did a month or a year ago.

name: Progress photos
desc: A weekly photo for long projects.

name: Small wins journal
desc: Three wins a day. (Progress principle)

name: Projects
desc: Each one holds its sessions, tasks and proof.

name: Why line
desc: One sentence on why the project matters to you.

name: Breakdown wizard
desc: Keeps asking "what is the first physical action?" until every task is under 25 minutes.

name: AI task splitter
desc: Paste an assignment, get the steps.

name: Next action
desc: Every project always has one defined.

name: Size labels
desc: 2, 15, 25 or 50 minutes.

name: Estimate correction
desc: Multiplies your guess by your own past ratio. (Planning fallacy)

name: Estimate versus actual
desc: Tracked per task.

name: Urgent-important matrix
desc: A four-box view of all tasks.

name: One Big Thing
desc: A single must-do each day.

name: 1-3-5 list
desc: One big, three medium, five small.

name: Frog flag
desc: Marks the task to do first.

name: Work-in-progress limit
desc: Three active projects at most.

name: Someday shelf
desc: A place for ideas that are not for now.

name: Stuck button
desc: Options: shrink it, ask someone, switch for 10 minutes.

name: Dread score
desc: Rate how much you dread a task. The most dreaded pays bonus XP.

name: Vague-task check
desc: Flags tasks with no action verb.

name: Templates
desc: Lab record, assignment, exam prep, hackathon.

name: Milestones
desc: Each one gets a small celebration.

name: Head-start bar
desc: Progress bars begin at 10%. (Endowed progress)

name: Almost-there view
desc: "2 sessions left to finish." (Goal gradient)

name: Open-loop hook
desc: Half-done tasks stay visible to pull you back. (Zeigarnik effect)

name: Dependencies
desc: What must finish before what.

name: Project retro
desc: Three questions when a project ends.

name: Evening plan
desc: Three minutes to set tomorrow.

name: Morning confirm
desc: One tap to accept the plan.

name: Time blocks
desc: Tasks placed on a day timeline.

name: Timetable import
desc: Your college schedule, so free slots are visible.

name: Free-slot finder
desc: Suggests sessions in gaps between lectures.

name: Realistic capacity
desc: Caps the plan at your 14-day average.

name: Big rocks first
desc: The top three are scheduled before anything else.

name: Theme days
desc: For example, Saturday is project day.

name: Weekly review
desc: Ten guided minutes on Sunday.

name: Weekly targets
desc: Sessions per project.

name: WOOP
desc: Wish, outcome, obstacle, plan for each weekly goal. (Mental contrasting)

name: Obstacle pre-mortem
desc: "What will stop me tomorrow?"

name: Locked first task
desc: Tomorrow's first task cannot be edited after 10 pm. (Precommitment)

name: Shutdown ritual
desc: An end-of-day checklist that ends with "shutdown complete."

name: Buffer blocks
desc: Empty slots for overruns.

name: Plan versus actual
desc: Both shown on one timeline.

name: One-tap reschedule
desc: Tasks never carry over silently.

name: Carry-over flag
desc: Tasks moved three times are marked.

name: Energy matching
desc: Hard tasks go in your peak hours.

name: Commute list
desc: Tasks for the bus.

name: Dead-time list
desc: Five-minute tasks for gaps.

name: 12-week goals
desc: Quarter-length goals instead of year-long ones.

name: Inputs over outcomes
desc: Track sessions done, not marks hoped for. (Lead measures)

name: Weekly scoreboard
desc: One screen showing the week's numbers.

name: App blocker
desc: Chosen apps are blocked during sessions.

name: Allow-list
desc: Calls and music stay available.

name: Strict lock
desc: No exit for the first N minutes.

name: Greyscale prompt
desc: Suggests turning the phone grey during work hours.

name: Face-down start
desc: Putting the phone face down starts the session.

name: Pickup counter
desc: Counts how often you lift the phone.

name: Urge surfing
desc: When you want to quit, wait 90 seconds and breathe, then choose.

name: Ten-minute rule
desc: Want Instagram? Allowed, after 10 more minutes.

name: Parking lot
desc: Jot the distracting thought and go back to work.

name: Unlock friction
desc: A 10-second delay and a typed reason to open a blocked app.

name: Scheduled scroll time
desc: Thirty guilt-free minutes a day.

name: Earned entertainment
desc: Fun apps unlock after sessions. (Premack principle)

name: Screen-time import
desc: Pulls the phone's usage numbers.

name: Time-thief report
desc: The top three apps eating your day.

name: Website blocker
desc: A desktop browser extension.

name: Desk checklist
desc: Water, charger, tabs closed.

name: Single-tab pledge
desc: One tab for the session.

name: Place presets
desc: Library, room, lab, with focus results for each.

name: Focus score
desc: Per session, from pauses and pickups.

name: Deep or shallow tag
desc: Deep hours are counted separately.

name: Deep-hours target
desc: A daily goal, capped at about 4 hours.

name: Attention warm-up
desc: Sixty seconds of slow breathing before hard work.

name: Message batching
desc: A reminder to check messages only at set times.

name: Night lock
desc: A nudge to stop screens at your chosen hour.

name: Funny rank ladder
desc: From "Professional Postponer" through "Reluctant Starter" and "Daily Shower-Upper" to "Momentum Machine."

name: XP
desc: Earned for starts, minutes and proof.

name: Start-heavy XP
desc: At low ranks, starting pays more than long hours.

name: Levels
desc: A slow, steady curve.

name: Gentle rank decay
desc: Rank slips after 7 idle days.

name: Achievements
desc: Thirty at launch.

name: Hidden achievements
desc: Found only by doing them.

name: First-time badges
desc: First session, first upload, first early submission.

name: Reward chest
desc: A random bonus after some sessions. (Variable reward)

name: Daily quests
desc: Three small ones each day.

name: Coins
desc: Spent on themes and sounds.

name: Real-life reward shop
desc: You set rewards like chai or a movie and price them in coins.

name: Savings jar
desc: A rupee amount you set per session, saved toward something you want.

name: Skill trees
desc: One per skill: DSA, ML, web.

name: Avatar
desc: A character that grows with you.

name: Workshop builder
desc: Each session adds a brick to a building.

name: Seasons
desc: Twelve-week seasons, competing against your last one.

name: Personal records
desc: Best day, best week, longest streak.

name: Profile title
desc: Your current rank shown as a title.

name: Prestige
desc: After the top rank, start again with a star.

name: Bonus to lose
desc: You hold a bonus that disappears if you skip today. (Loss aversion)

name: Combo meter
desc: Rises with each session in a day.

name: No pay-to-win
desc: Nothing can be bought to skip the work.

name: Identity statement
desc: "I am someone who starts," shown at each session.

name: Votes
desc: Every action counts as one vote for that identity.

name: Evidence counter
desc: The vote total sits under the statement.

name: Belief check
desc: Write the old belief ("I never finish"). The app answers with your own logs.

name: "Not yet" wording
desc: Unfinished things are "not yet," never "failed." (Growth mindset)

name: Hard-things ladder
desc: A record of the hardest things you have done.

name: Future-self card
desc: A description of you in five years, in your words.

name: Letter to self
desc: Written now, delivered in 30 days.

name: Values pick
desc: Choose three values and link tasks to them.

name: Why chain
desc: Ask "why" five times about your main goal.

name: Anti-vision
desc: One paragraph on the life you get by drifting, viewable when you choose.

name: Vision card
desc: The 1-crore role described concretely: the work, the skills, the day.

name: Role-model board
desc: One principle each from people you admire.

name: Personal rules
desc: For example, "I never skip Monday."

name: Start mantra
desc: A line of your choice on the start screen.

name: Name talk
desc: Prompts in the third person: "Winzo, start the timer." (Distanced self-talk)

name: Effort praise
desc: The app praises the work done, never talent.

name: Standards page
desc: The daily minimum you refuse to go below.

name: Change timeline
desc: Month one compared with now.

name: Reframe library
desc: Common excuses with ready replies.

name: Excuse log
desc: Write the excuse, then write your answer to it.

name: "Did it anyway" tags
desc: Did it tired, bored or scared.

name: Effort rating
desc: Rate the day by effort, not result.

name: Personal constitution
desc: A one-page document you write and sign.

name: Mood check
desc: One tap before a session.

name: Name the feeling
desc: Bored, anxious, overwhelmed or confused. (Affect labelling)

name: Matched fix
desc: Overwhelmed: shrink the task. Confused: write the question. Bored: race the timer. Anxious: ugly draft.

name: Explainer card
desc: A short note that procrastination is about emotion, not laziness.

name: Avoidance detector
desc: Flags the most-postponed tasks and asks what feeling is behind them.

name: Aversion type
desc: Mark a task as boring, hard, unclear or pointless, and get a fix for that type.

name: Worry dump
desc: Two minutes of writing worries before starting.

name: Box breathing
desc: Sixty seconds.

name: "Good enough" line
desc: Define what done looks like for each task. Guards against perfectionism.

name: Fear-setting
desc: Worst case, how to prevent it, how to repair it.

name: Shame-free language
desc: A rule for every screen and message.

name: Forgive yesterday
desc: A button that closes the day. Studies of students link self-forgiveness to less procrastination later.

name: Overwhelm mode
desc: Hides everything except one task.

name: Boredom training
desc: Five minutes with no stimulation, to build tolerance.

name: Discomfort reps
desc: Counts the times you started without feeling like it.

name: Action-first card
desc: Reminds you that motivation usually arrives after starting.

name: Mood after
desc: A graph showing you feel better after sessions than before.

name: Trigger log
desc: What you did instead: reels, sleep, games.

name: Replacement plan
desc: "If I want to open reels, I do one 2-minute session first."

name: Company prompt
desc: Suggests working beside someone when you have been alone for long.

name: Stress meter
desc: Weekly. High stress brings a lighter plan.

name: Burnout warning
desc: Rising hours with falling mood triggers a rest day.

name: Gratitude line
desc: One sentence a day.

name: Support prompt
desc: If mood stays low for two weeks, the app suggests talking to someone you trust or a counsellor.

name: Instant celebration
desc: A small animation and a fist-pump prompt the second you finish. (Celebration wires in habits)

name: Sleep log
desc: Hours per night.

name: Wind-down alarm
desc: A reminder 45 minutes before bed.

name: Protected sleep window
desc: The app will not schedule sessions inside it.

name: Energy check
desc: Rate 1 to 5, three times a day.

name: Peak-hours map
desc: Shows when you focus best.

name: Morning or night type
desc: A setting that shifts the schedule.

name: Morning light reminder
desc: Ten minutes outside after waking.

name: Movement break
desc: Every 50 minutes.

name: Walk session
desc: A 10-minute walk counts as recovery.

name: Exercise streak
desc: Minimum of five push-ups.

name: Meal log
desc: Flags skipped meals on work days.

name: Caffeine cut-off
desc: A reminder in the afternoon.

name: Nap timer
desc: Twenty minutes.

name: Eye rest
desc: Every 20 minutes, look far away for 20 seconds.

name: 90/20 mode
desc: Ninety minutes of work, twenty of rest.

name: Planned rest day
desc: One each week.

name: Recovery score
desc: From sleep, breaks and rest days.

name: Active rest menu
desc: Walk, stretch, music, talk to a friend.

name: Screen-free breaks
desc: Counted separately.

name: Sunday reset
desc: Clean desk, plan week, prepare bag.

name: Basics check
desc: Sleep, food and movement confirmed before sprint mode unlocks.

name: Hours warning
desc: Fires when hours rise while output falls.

name: Buddy pairing
desc: One accountability partner.

name: Auto check-in
desc: A daily summary sent to your buddy.

name: Shared session room
desc: A synced timer for two or more.

name: Fail-together mode
desc: Optional: if one person quits, the group session fails.

name: Who is working now
desc: A quiet list of friends in a session.

name: Body doubling
desc: A video link to work beside someone.

name: Class squad
desc: A group for your section.

name: Consistency leaderboard
desc: Ranked by days shown up, not hours.

name: Seven-day duel
desc: Head to head with a friend.

name: Commitment contract
desc: A written promise with a stake.

name: Small money stake
desc: Optional, paid to a friend or charity if you miss.

name: Forfeit
desc: Your buddy picks a harmless penalty.

name: Mentor view
desc: A senior or teacher sees your weekly digest.

name: Family report
desc: Optional weekly summary.

name: Build in public
desc: Auto-drafts a daily progress post.

name: Cheers
desc: Reactions from friends.

name: Help request
desc: Ask the squad when stuck.

name: Teaching credit
desc: Explaining a topic to a buddy counts as a session.

name: Group deadline board
desc: For team projects.

name: Team roles
desc: Who owns what in a group project.

name: Privacy controls
desc: Choose exactly what each person can see.

name: Five-minute blocks
desc: Plan the day in very small blocks, a scheduling style widely reported of Elon Musk.

name: First-principles card
desc: Break a problem down to what is certainly true, then rebuild.

name: Sprint week
desc: One week at high hours with sleep protected, followed by a lighter recovery week.

name: Intensity dial
desc: Normal, Push or Sprint, chosen each week.

name: Regret test
desc: "At 80, will I regret skipping this?" (Bezos's regret minimisation)

name: 25/5 list
desc: Write 25 goals, keep 5, avoid the other 20. (Attributed to Buffett)

name: Franklin's two questions
desc: Morning: what good shall I do today? Evening: what good have I done?

name: Virtue of the week
desc: One trait to practise, tracked daily. (Franklin's chart)

name: Early session badge
desc: A session before college starts, as athletes train before the day begins.

name: Deliberate practice session
desc: Work at the edge of your ability with instant feedback. (Ericsson)

name: Feynman technique
desc: Explain the topic in simple words and find the gaps.

name: Deep work blocks
desc: Long, protected, distraction-free blocks. (Newport)

name: One percent better
desc: Log one small improvement a day. (Kaizen)

name: Six-task list
desc: Six tasks, ranked, done in order. (Ivy Lee method)

name: 80/20 finder
desc: Shows which fifth of your tasks produced most results. (Pareto)

name: Shorter boxes
desc: Give tasks less time so they fill less time. (Parkinson's law)

name: Stoic morning
desc: Picture today's obstacles in advance.

name: Stoic evening
desc: What went well, what went badly, what changes tomorrow.

name: Inversion
desc: "How would I guarantee failure?" Then avoid that list. (Munger)

name: Hamming question
desc: What is the most important problem in my field, and why am I not working on it?

name: Build and sell
desc: Track both making things and showing them. (Naval)

name: Pain log
desc: Record each setback with the lesson. (Dalio: pain plus reflection)

name: Say-no list
desc: What you turned down this week to protect focus. (Jobs)

name: Maker's schedule
desc: Half-day blocks with no interruptions. (Paul Graham)

name: Ask for criticism
desc: A weekly prompt to request honest feedback on your work.

name: Target role card
desc: The role, example companies and skills required.

name: Skill gap map
desc: Where you are against what the role needs.

name: Skill roadmaps
desc: Milestones per skill.

name: Daily DSA streak
desc: One problem a day.

name: Problem count sync
desc: From coding sites, or entered by hand.

name: Pattern tracker
desc: Which problem types you have covered.

name: Ship monthly
desc: One finished project every month.

name: Commit mirror
desc: Your GitHub squares shown in the app.

name: Open-source counter
desc: Contributions merged.

name: Competition log
desc: Hackathons and Kaggle entries.

name: Paper a week
desc: One research paper read and summarised.
